reviews.review: Now that the patches and fixes it deserved have finally started to unfold, this game is honestly alot of fun especially with friends! each character has vastly different playstyles and lots of mechanics that are fun to explore. The graphics look amazing and hardly any bugs or glitches happen anymore! [which was a pretty big problem on its release lol] Therefore I'm really hoping this game can find the love of a good community and hopefully get more new and exciting content overtime 8/10 would recommend.. Go hunt some vampires!

I understand the disappointment at the release of the game and still, you can't miss the obvious shortcuts taken by devs. Potential has been missed unfortunately. 
That said, I also must say, I actually had some fun playing earlier on and after the last big release/update, the game gave me a better experience. And I also did have fun playing this game lately to be honest. I tried out 3 characters and finished the game with 1 (solo). I see myself potentially returning to complete the game with the other characters one day, perhaps with friends in co-op. Each character has it's own gameplay to a certain level and can make your experience different, which promotes replayability.

Is the game on Triple A level? No.
Worth the full (release) price? No.
Worth buying on sale? Yes (which I did).
Is the game fun to play? Yes (solo and co-op), but don't expect a triple A level game.

I took my time exploring and fooling around a bit and came close to 30 hours playtime with 1 character form start 'till end, which was fun to do. Depending on your gameplay, I think you'd certainly get 20-25 hours out of a playthrough.

Redfall had a lot of potential. The setting is great and some of the designs are really striking. At some times, it almost feels like a page out of a Goosebumps novel. Sadly, Redfall was a terrible game on release for a multitudes of reasons and it was not given a real chance at post-launch success. The decision is logical but still disappointing. As it is now, the game is basically a sort of "low-tier" Halloween x Borderlands x Far Cry mashup. For less than 20$, you can get your fun out of it, but only if you approach it with low expectations.
One of the Worst Games Ever..

I get that this launched badly, but I picked it up recently for a massive discount and tbh I absolutely love it. Have had zero technical issues at all so far, and I'm getting a solid 60fps across the board on max settings. If your idea of a good time is a Stephen King / Lovecraftian-esque open world vampire game akin to a more condensed Far Cry, with elements of Dead Island thrown in I'd honestly recommend Redfall. Absolutely love the small town Maine setting, and once you've levelled up a bit and have a couple of decent weapons on you, it's an absolute blast. Fun combination of story and side quests too, without the map being completely overrun with way too much stuff to do. I honestly feel like the team got a really bad rap here due to launch issues, and it's a shame as I would loved to have seen this do well and get a bigger sequel.
